sections.content: Combine the pretérito indefinido with direct and indirect questions to recount an interview. Ask direct questions when speaking to the interviewee and use reporting verbs to tell someone what was asked: Preguntó qué pasó. Quiso saber dónde trabajó. Preguntó quién llegó primero.

items.english: She wanted to know where he worked.

items.spanish: Después preguntó cómo empezó el oficio.
items.english: Then she asked how the craft began.

sections.content: In an indirect question, keep normal statement word order: Preguntó qué pasó, not a direct-question structure.
